paragraphs: A fast, opinionated powerline-style prompt written in Rust. It understands git and GitHub, detects Rust, Python, Node and Java project environments, and can show your Claude or Codex subscription usage, with async rendering support for the slower lookups. It can draw Claude Code's status line too.
With the gh CLI installed, it also links to the current branch's pull request and shows its CI status:
superline started as a fork of cirho/powerline-rust, itself a pure-Rust take on powerline-shell, and has since grown a set of opinionated but configurable modules and themes.
features: Fast: a few tens of milliseconds per prompt, git status included.
Lazy: backends only run when needed, so there is no git cost outside a git repo and no Python cost outside a
Never blocks: slow lookups (git status on big repos, PR status, AI usage) are refreshed in the background and
Flexible layout: multiple rows, each with an optional right-aligned side.
